traceability.notes: The 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING story is fully implemented. All relevant ESLint rules define clear, specific, and consistent error messages using shared patterns and placeholders. These messages provide precise context (function names, file paths, requirement IDs, human-readable details) and, where appropriate, suggestions or auto-fixes. RuleTester-based unit tests and custom harnesses validate that each rule’s error messages, data fields, and severities behave exactly as specified. The plugin configs in src/index.ts map rule severities according to the story’s severity conventions, and this mapping is explicitly tested. Edge cases such as missing files, filesystem errors, invalid paths, and incomplete context are handled gracefully and surfaced as diagnostics with explanatory messages rather than uncaught errors. Based on code, tests, and targeted test execution, all acceptance criteria and requirements in this story are satisfied.
